rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR BRAIN CT ANGIOGRAPHY / Aneurysm Screening
rules.source_quote: For one first degree relative with aneurysm, asymptomatic screening is not indicated and would require a neurological sign or symptom supporting clinical concern for aneurysm

criteria.description: Patient has only one first-degree relative with intracranial aneurysm
Patient is entirely asymptomatic without focal neurological signs or symptoms

required_documentation: Neurological evaluation notes documenting active symptoms if CTA is requested with single affected relative
exclusion_conditions: Routine asymptomatic intracranial aneurysm screening in patients with only one affected first-degree relative
rules.review_notes: Explicit policy exclusion requiring at least two first-degree relatives or neurological symptoms for aneurysm screening.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR BRAIN CT ANGIOGRAPHY / Evaluation of Known Intracranial Vascular Disease (1,2)
rules.source_quote: Evaluation of Known Intracranial Vascular Disease (1,2)

criteria.description: Acute ischemic stroke presentation being evaluated for large vessel occlusion (LVO) or mechanical thrombectomy eligibility

required_documentation: Emergency neurological exam documenting NIHSS score, last known well time, and acute focal deficits
rules.review_notes: Brain CTA indicated for acute stroke large vessel occlusion evaluation.
